title: Beyond the Point Mass: Acceptance-Derived Weights and Distributional Losses for Speculative Decoding
abstract: arXiv:2610.28355v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In speculative decoding, a lightweight draft model proposes tokens that the target model verifies in parallel, speeding up generation without changing the target distribution. D-PACE (Wu et al., 2026) trains such drafters with a loss that weights each position by its contribution to the expected accepted length. Both its weights and its cross-entropy (CE) loss use only the draft's probability of the recorded target token, treating the target as a point mass. Under rejection sampling, however, a sampled draft token is accepted with probability equal to the overlap of the draft and target distributions, one minus their total variation (TV). We derive D-PAL (Dynamic Position-wise Acceptance Loss) from the exact expected accepted length, using this overlap as the acceptance signal. This yields overlap-based position weights with log acceptance (LA) as the per-position loss, and the objective reduces to D-PACE for a point-mass target. Since t

translated_title: 超越点质量：用于推测解码的基于接受率的权重与分布式损失
translated_abstract: 在推测解码中，一个轻量级的草稿模型提出词元，由目标模型并行验证，从而在不改变目标分布的前提下加速生成。D-PACE（Wu et al., 2026）通过一种按每个位置对期望接受长度的贡献进行加权的损失来训练这类草稿模型。然而，其权重和交叉熵（CE）损失都仅使用草稿模型对被记录目标词元的概率，将目标分布视为点质量。但在拒绝采样机制下，采样出的草稿词元被接受的概率等于草稿分布与目标分布的重叠度，即一减去二者的总变差（TV）。我们从精确的期望接受长度出发推导出 D-PAL（动态逐位置接受损失），将该重叠度用作接受信号。这带来了基于重叠度的位置权重，并以对数接受率（LA）作为逐位置损失，且该目标函数在目标为点质量时退化为 D-PACE。
tldr: 本文提出 D-PAL（动态逐位置接受损失），从精确期望接受长度出发，用草稿与目标分布的重叠度（1减总变差）取代点质量假设下的交叉熵信号，以基于重叠度的位置权重配合对数接受率作为逐位置损失来训练推测解码的草稿模型，且在目标为点质量时该目标函数退化为 D-PACE。
en_tdlr: We propose D-PAL (Dynamic Position-wise Acceptance Loss), which derives training signals for speculative decoding drafters from the exact expected accepted length, replacing the point-mass cross-entropy with the draft-target distributional overlap (1 − TV), yielding overlap-based position weights and a log acceptance per-position loss that reduces to D-PACE for a point-mass target.
